hypothesis: the pre-submission gate set catches 100% of 5 seeded defect classes (hallucinated ref, drifted number, swallowed exit, unhedged inconclusive, stale manifest) on fixture manuscripts

kill_switch.note: 0 escapes: extend to real manuscripts as test corpus
any escape means the pipeline is theater for that class; fix the checker, not the test

tension: ICLR desk-rejects papers for defects a script could catch before submission, while venues bolt AI onto review after the fact. A pre-submission pipeline is either enforcement or theater, and the only way to know is to plant defects and count escapes. Nobody has published that number.
